relationships.subject: infralimbic GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: The intraperitoneal injection of CNO into VGAT: hM3Dq mice activated GABAergic neurons in the IL region and increased PWT

relationships.subject: infralimbic glutamatergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: activation of glutamatergic neurons in the IL region by injection of CNO into VGLUT2:hM3Dq mice did not produce an analgesic effect

relationships.subject: asiaticoside
relationships.evidence_quote: our study demonstrates that AS alleviates BCP by selectively targeting GABAergic neurons in the infralimbic cortex

key_findings: Asiaticoside alleviates bone cancer pain and preferentially activates IL GABAergic neurons.
Chemogenetic activation of IL GABAergic, not glutamatergic, neurons is analgesic.
